value.rationale: A cost-neutral stage-coupling choice strictly improves two-step mean-square contraction at every positive scaled step and enlarges the sharp stable interval from 1.59607... to 1.89655... (18.8% gain), with explicit rational regime where iid diverges but paired decays. Invariance of the Lyapunov exponent separates mean-square reliability from almost-sure stability without changing stage marginals. Natural test-equation stability is useful for randomized integrator design; extension to general ODEs remains unproved.
